say:3:1029304001:1.text: Fay! And you're... Marilee's friends! Are you looking for her?
say:3:1029304001:1.source_cn: 菲，还有你……是小梅的魔法师朋友！你们来找小梅吗？
say:3:1029304001:1.male: Fay! And you're... Marilee's friends! Are you looking for her?
say:3:1029304001:1.female: Fay! And you're... Marilee's friends! Are you looking for her?

say:4:1029304002:1.source_cn: 不是的，梅拉奶奶，我们是来找你的！

say:5:1029304003:1.text: Oh, you're here to help? Great! I was just getting a bit anxious about how I was going to pick enough hexaflowers. Making tea requires a lot!
say:5:1029304003:1.source_cn: 哦，你们是来帮我的？太好了，我正好在犯愁怎么收集到足够...

say:6:1029304004:1.text: Why don't you help me gather the hexaflowers? And remember not to damage the leaves! Thank you so much, youngsters.
say:6:1029304004:1.source_cn: 那你们帮我收集一些花朵吧，记得千万不要损坏花瓣啊。麻烦...

say:7:1029304005:1.text: Uhh... How did we end up helping gather hexaflowers?
say:7:1029304005:1.source_cn: 呃……我们怎么突然变成来帮忙收集花瓣的人了？

say:8:1029304006:1.text: Well, actually, Grandma Mera's hearing isn't what it once was. She probably misheard...
say:8:1029304006:1.source_cn: 那个，其实梅拉奶奶的耳朵稍微有点问题，应该是听错了……
